name: Vector to Closest Point (VCP) Octree
definition: A surface representation storing a vector field where each grid point stores a vector to the closest point on the original geometry. It stores direction and distance, allowing normals to be derived from interpolating VCP vectors rather than stored explicitly.
summary: The VCP Octree is a hierarchical sparse data structure for surface ray-casting that stores vectors to the closest surface point, preventing feature blurring during interpolation unlike standard scalar distance fields.
